name: Aaron Howearth
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Queer- and neurodiversity-affirming therapy and diagnostic assessments of neurodivergent characteristics (ADHD, Autism and Learning differences), in person or by telehealth. Aaron uses EMDR, CBT, ACT, schema therapy, somatic therapy and mindfulness-based therapy.
specialties: queer-affirming, EMDR, schema therapy, somatic therapy, neurodiversity-affirming, ADHD/autism assessment, eating disorders

name: Dani (Howearth Psychology)
title: Psychologist
description: Psychologist at a queer- and neurodiversity-affirming practice, offering online support to people across Australia; draws on CBT and Gestalt therapy.

name: Luke Samios
title: Counsellor (Master of Counselling)
description: Counselling for adults and young people with a particular focus on supporting LGBTQIA+ clients, including trauma, anxiety, depression, grief and relationship difficulties. Trauma-informed, strengths-based and evidence-informed; LGBTIQ owned and operated.

name: Eva Koukoura
title: Counsellor (ACA member)
description: Queer-affirming counselling for LGBTQIA+ adults covering anxiety, relationships, identity, self-worth and life transitions. Person-centred and holistic, drawing on narrative and somatic therapies; online counselling across Australia. LGBTIQ owned and operated.
specialties: queer-affirming, LGBTQIA+, identity, narrative therapy, somatic therapy

name: Brydan Xavier
title: Psychologist
description: (Updated record) Offers gender-affirming care, is kink and BDSM-friendly, and focuses on adults, especially men and the LGBTIQAPSB+ community. Eclectic, trauma-informed approach drawing on CBT, DBT, ACT and EMDR; interest in gender, sexuality, sex and intimacy issues and trauma.
specialties: gender-affirming, kink/BDSM-friendly, LGBTIQA+, EMDR, trauma, sexuality, sex and intimacy
